resources.string: Presses the Skip button in YouTube and YouTube Music for you as soon as it appears. It never blocks ads.

Presses the Skip button in the YouTube and YouTube Music apps for you once it appears, and can mute ads while they play. It only looks at those two apps, never reads other apps, keeps nothing it sees, and has no internet access.
Watching %1$s. Play something with an ad to try it.
Both apps are switched off below, so AutoSkip isn\'t doing anything.
Turn on AutoSkip in Accessibility settings. Android doesn\'t let apps do this for themselves.
Android has stopped the service. In Accessibility settings, turn AutoSkip off and on again, then check that battery saving isn\'t closing this app.

What it accesses: AutoSkip uses Android\'s Accessibility API to read the screens of the YouTube and YouTube Music apps, so it can find the Skip button and press it. It reads nothing from other apps, stores nothing it sees, and cannot send data anywhere because it has no internet permission.
Neither YouTube nor YouTube Music is installed on this phone. AutoSkip only works with the official apps.
Switch greyed out, or a \"Restricted setting\" message?

Android 13 and later block Accessibility for apps installed from a downloaded APK. Open App info, tap the three-dot menu at the top right, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", confirm, then come back and turn AutoSkip on. Installing from Android Studio or with adb avoids this.
Press Skip as soon as it appears
Seconds to wait before pressing Skip
Also silences ads that have no Skip button, such as audio ads in YouTube Music. Sound comes back when the ad ends, or press a volume key.
Writes what AutoSkip sees to logcat (tag AutoSkip). Use it to fix AutoSkip after a YouTube or YouTube Music update.
Not affiliated with YouTube or Google. Skippable ads only: AutoSkip presses the button the app already shows you. Ads without a Skip button still play (you can mute them).
This phone has no such settings screen. Open Settings and search for Accessibility.
